quizName:
Sign Test
									  					
									  														  					Check how well you know road signs.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Orange construction signs warn you about construction zones. This sign tells you a flagger is ahead. Follow their directions.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: Cars in right lane must slow down.
Pass only in the right lane.

questions.explanation: This sign warns that two lanes of traffic going the same direction are about to become one lane.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are usually yellow with black markings. They alert you to hazards ahead. This sign warns you that cattle may cross the road.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign tells you to wait for the left turn signal before turning left. Only turn when the signal tells you it is safe.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: You must come to a complete stop.
Drive with caution and be ready to stop.

questions.correctAnswerText: You must come to a complete stop.
questions.explanation: An eight-sided sign always means stop. You must come to a complete stop. Wait for vehicles and pedestrians to clear before moving.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign tells you how long you can park. You may park for a maximum of two hours during the posted times.

questions.question: If you see this sign, you should:

options.text: Keep your speed the same until you reach the reduced speed zone.
Start to slow down your vehicle.
Not slow down because traffic will back up.
Slow down only if you want to.

questions.correctAnswerText: Start to slow down your vehicle.
questions.explanation: This sign tells you to begin slowing down. The new speed limit will start at the next speed limit sign.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign marks reserved parking spaces in parking lots. These spaces are for vehicles with a handicap sticker, tag, or license plate only.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns that a divided highway is ahead. The road splits into two one-way roadways with a median between them. Stay on the right side.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns of a pedestrian crossing ahead. Watch for people walking across the road. Slow down and be ready to stop.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign tells you not to make a U-turn at this location.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: The road ahead curves left, then right.
The road ahead curves right, then left.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road ahead curves right, then left.
questions.explanation: This sign warns that the road curves to the right and then to the left. Slow down to safely navigate these curves.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns that deer cross the road in this area. Slow down, stay alert, and be ready to stop.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: Traffic flows only in the direction of the arrow.

questions.correctAnswerText: Traffic flows only in the direction of the arrow.
questions.explanation: This one-way sign shows that traffic can only move in the direction the arrow points.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Watch for traffic on your right.
Don't park on the right side of the street.

questions.explanation: A red circle with a slash over a symbol means that action is not allowed. This sign means no right turn.

questions.question: When you see this black and yellow sign, what does it mean?

options.text: The road to the right is for one-way traffic only.
That due to upcoming roadwork, there is a detour to the right.
Slow down because the road ahead changes direction at an extreme angle.
There is a crossroad to your right.

questions.correctAnswerText: Slow down because the road ahead changes direction at an extreme angle.
questions.explanation: This sign warns that the road ahead turns sharply in one direction. Slow down as much as you would at an intersection.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Five-sided signs warn you there is a school nearby. Watch for children and pedestrians. Obey crossing guards if present.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign is a regulation sign that tells you parking is not allowed in this location.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This yellow warning sign tells you the road ahead has several curves. Slow down and adjust your speed.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This regulation sign shows the lowest legal speed you can drive. Do not drive slower than this speed.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: A red traffic light is ahead.
The traffic light ahead is broken.
A green traffic light is ahead.

questions.explanation: This sign warns you that there is a traffic light at the next intersection.

questions.question: When you see this sign, you must:

options.text: Stop completely. Look for pedestrians and traffic crossing.
Stop completely and wait for a green light.
Slow down and check for traffic.

questions.correctAnswerText: Stop completely. Look for pedestrians and traffic crossing.
questions.explanation: An eight-sided sign is a stop sign. You must stop completely, then check for pedestrians and traffic before you go. Wait until the intersection is clear.

questions.question: This sign means:

options.text: Stop only if cars are coming.

questions.explanation: This sign shows where bicycles cross or ride near traffic. Drive carefully in this area because cyclists may be present.

questions.question: This sign means:
questions.explanation: A three-sided sign tells you to slow down at the intersection ahead. Be ready to stop for other drivers or pedestrians. Go when it is safe.

questions.question: This sign means:
questions.explanation: This sign tells you not to enter. It is often placed at the end of one-way streets to stop drivers from entering the wrong way. Stop and turn around if you see this sign.

questions.question: This sign means:
questions.explanation: This yellow warning sign alerts you to a traffic light ahead. Be ready to stop for a red or yellow light, or for traffic crossing.

questions.question: This sign means:
questions.explanation: This sign tells drivers in the left lane that they must turn left.

questions.question: This sign means:
questions.explanation: This sign warns that a steep hill is coming.

questions.question: This sign means:
questions.explanation: A circular sign means a railroad crossing is ahead. Watch for trains.

questions.question: This sign means:
questions.explanation: This sign tells you the road ahead is a divided highway. Stay to the right of the center divider.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: A red circle with a red slash through it means something is not allowed. This sign means you cannot turn right.

questions.question: A driver's left arm is extended upward. What does this hand signal mean?
questions.explanation: When a driver's left arm points up, they are signaling a right turn. Be ready to adjust your driving if you see this signal.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Yellow signs with black markings warn drivers about road hazards. This sign warns you that a narrow bridge is coming ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Yellow signs with black markings warn drivers about road hazards. This sign tells you to watch for people crossing the road.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Traffic is entering from the right.

questions.correctAnswerText: Traffic is entering from the right.
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that other vehicles will be merging into traffic from the right side.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: The road is slippery when wet.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road is slippery when wet.
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that the road becomes very slippery when it rains or gets wet.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: You are about to enter a one-way street the wrong way.
Do not drive in this lane.
Left-turning traffic must yield to oncoming traffic on a green light.

questions.correctAnswerText: Left-turning traffic must yield to oncoming traffic on a green light.
questions.explanation: This sign used with a traffic light tells drivers turning left that they do not have the right-of-way. They must wait for oncoming traffic to pass.

questions.question: What does this sign tell you?

options.text: No turns are allowed on this road.
The road may be slippery when wet.

questions.explanation: This sign warns you that the road has three or more curves coming up.

questions.question: What do these signs indicate?
questions.explanation: Yellow signs with black markings warn drivers about hazards. These object markers warn you about things or areas that could be dangerous and should be avoided.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Five-sided signs mean a school is nearby. Watch for children and pedestrians. This sign means there is a school crossing or school zone.

questions.question: What should you do at a yield sign?

options.text: Always stop before entering the intersection.
Yield only to traffic on the right.
Yield only to traffic on the left.
Slow down and let other traffic go first.

questions.correctAnswerText: Slow down and let other traffic go first.
questions.explanation: A yield sign means you must slow down and let other traffic pass before entering the intersection.

questions.question: What should you do when you see a railroad crossing sign?

options.text: Look for a train station ahead.
Slow down and let trains pass.

questions.correctAnswerText: Slow down and let trains pass.
questions.explanation: This sign warns of a railroad crossing ahead. You must slow down when you see it. Trains cannot stop for cars, so you must wait for them to pass before crossing the tracks.

questions.question: What does a keep right sign mean?

options.text: Stay on the side shown by the arrow.
You may drive in the left lane.

questions.correctAnswerText: Stay on the side shown by the arrow.
questions.explanation: This sign tells you to keep to the right side because there is an island, median, or barrier ahead.

questions.question: What does a low clearance sign mean?

options.text: The overpass ahead is too low for tall vehicles.
Two lanes of traffic are about to merge.

questions.correctAnswerText: The overpass ahead is too low for tall vehicles.
questions.explanation: This sign warns that the overpass ahead has low clearance. Do not go under it if your vehicle is taller than the height shown on the sign.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Highway changes ahead and to the right.
Hiking trails ahead and to the right.
Hotel ahead and to the right.
Hospital ahead and to the right.

questions.correctAnswerText: Hospital ahead and to the right.
questions.explanation: This sign shows that a hospital with emergency services is located to the right.

questions.question: What does a workers ahead sign mean?

options.text: A cleanup group is picking up trash along the highway.
Workers are on or near the road in the work zone ahead.
There is a pedestrian crosswalk ahead.

questions.correctAnswerText: Workers are on or near the road in the work zone ahead.
questions.explanation: This sign warns that workers may be on or near the road ahead. Drive carefully through the work zone.

questions.question: What does a curve sign with a speed limit mean?

options.text: The road curves right ahead. Slow to the safe speed shown.
Divided highway begins. Slow to the safe speed shown.
Merge ahead. Slow to the safe speed shown.
Winding road ahead. Slow to the safe speed shown.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road curves right ahead. Slow to the safe speed shown.
questions.explanation: This sign tells you the road curves to the right ahead and shows the safe speed to drive (in this case, 35 mph).

questions.question: What does a low clearance sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns that the overpass ahead is too low. Do not go under it if your vehicle is taller than the height shown on the sign.

questions.question: What does a curve ahead sign mean?
questions.explanation: Yellow warning signs with black markings alert you to road conditions ahead. This sign warns drivers that a curve is coming.

questions.question: What does a no turn on red sign mean?

options.text: You cannot turn right when the light is red.

questions.correctAnswerText: You cannot turn right when the light is red.
questions.explanation: This regulation sign is posted at traffic lights where turning right on a red light is not allowed. You must follow this rule.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Drive with the flow of traffic.
Keep your speed down for the next 50 miles.
Speed limits are enforced for the next 50 miles.
The speed limit is 50 miles per hour.

questions.correctAnswerText: The speed limit is 50 miles per hour.
questions.explanation: A speed limit sign shows the maximum safe speed you can drive.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that a traffic light is coming up ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Fines are doubled in work zones.

questions.correctAnswerText: Fines are doubled in work zones.
questions.explanation: Construction zones are dangerous for drivers and workers. Orange signs warn you about construction. This sign tells you that penalties for unsafe driving are doubled in work zones.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. They prepare you for road hazards. This sign warns you about a steep downhill. Slow down to protect your brakes and avoid crashes.

questions.question: If you see this sign above your lane, what should you do?

options.text: You can either continue on the freeway or exit from your current lane.
You can stay in your lane and continue on the freeway.
You must exit if you stay in your current lane.

questions.correctAnswerText: You must exit if you stay in your current lane.
questions.explanation: An "Exit only" sign means your lane does not continue on the freeway. If you stay in that lane, you will exit. You can change lanes to stay on the freeway, or you must exit if you remain in that lane.

questions.question: If you see this sign, what should you do?

options.text: You can pass a slow vehicle if you do it quickly.
You can pass if you know the road ahead.
You can pass, but only at night.

questions.explanation: Regulation signs are white with black markings. You must follow all regulation signs. Where this sign is posted, you cannot pass other vehicles.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Regulation signs control traffic and show rules you must obey. Large trucks are not allowed where this sign is posted.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns you about an upcoming intersection. Watch carefully for other vehicles crossing.

questions.question: What does a yellow and black diamond-shaped sign mean?

options.text: It warns you about road conditions or hazards ahead.
It helps you find cities and towns ahead.
It tells you about traffic laws and rules.
It tells you about construction ahead.

questions.correctAnswerText: It warns you about road conditions or hazards ahead.
questions.explanation: Warning signs are diamond-shaped with black symbols on yellow. They alert you to conditions and hazards on or near the road ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: A lane is ending or the road is getting narrower.

questions.correctAnswerText: A lane is ending or the road is getting narrower.
questions.explanation: Warning signs are diamond-shaped with black markings on yellow. They alert you to hazards ahead. This sign warns you that the right lane is ending or the road ahead is narrower.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Slow down if an emergency vehicle is coming.
Look both ways as you cross the intersection.
Always come to a full stop at the intersection.
Slow down and be ready to stop if needed.

questions.correctAnswerText: Slow down and be ready to stop if needed.
questions.explanation: Slow down as you approach a yield sign. Be ready to stop and let other vehicles and pedestrians cross first. You must stop if traffic requires it.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that a steep hill is coming.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: There is a bus stop ahead.
There is a stop sign ahead.
There is a warning sign ahead.
You must stop if other cars stop.

questions.correctAnswerText: There is a stop sign ahead.
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. They warn drivers about hazards ahead. This sign tells you a stop sign is coming, so get ready to stop.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns that the divided highway is ending ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign means drivers from both directions can use the shared center lane only for turning left. Do not use this lane for regular driving.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. They tell you about hazards ahead. This sign warns you that a sharp turn is coming and you should reduce your speed.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Slow down and be ready to stop if cars are coming.
Stop completely and then go when it is safe.
Go carefully through the intersection without always stopping.
Stop only for traffic on the crossing road.

questions.correctAnswerText: Stop completely and then go when it is safe.
questions.explanation: A stop sign means you must stop completely. Let other vehicles and pedestrians cross first. Go again when it is safe.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. They tell you about hazards ahead. This sign warns you that a T intersection is coming. Be ready to turn left or right.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Slow down when the road is wet.
The road ahead has a series of curves.

questions.correctAnswerText: Slow down when the road is wet.
questions.explanation: This sign warns that the road is slippery when wet. Reduce your speed, avoid sudden braking or turning, and stay farther away from the car ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign tells drivers to stay in the right lane to avoid a hazard ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Orange signs warn you about construction ahead. This sign tells you to follow a detour because the road ahead is closed for work.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: There is a steep hill ahead.
No trucks are allowed on an upcoming hill.
There are trucks on an upcoming hill.

questions.correctAnswerText: There is a steep hill ahead.
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that a steep hill or downgrade is coming.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Fines double in a work zone.

questions.explanation: Yellow signs warn you about road hazards ahead. This sign tells you the overhead clearance is low. Tall vehicles may not fit.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Orange signs warn you about construction ahead. This sign tells you that construction ahead will change your route. Be ready to follow the detour.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Be ready for a sharp left turn.
Watch for people crossing the road.
Follow the detour to avoid unsafe driving conditions.

questions.correctAnswerText: Follow the detour to avoid unsafe driving conditions.
questions.explanation: This sign shows that the traffic pattern has changed due to construction. Follow the detour that is marked.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: The left lane is only for vehicles with a certain number of passengers.
You can only turn in certain directions from certain lanes.

questions.correctAnswerText: The left lane is only for vehicles with a certain number of passengers.
questions.explanation: This sign marks a HOV (high occupancy vehicle) lane. Only buses and cars with the required number of passengers can use this lane.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign tells you not to enter the intersection if traffic ahead is stopped. Do not block the intersection.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: A red circle with a red line through it means something is not allowed. This sign means you cannot make a U-turn at this location.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that traffic is moving in both directions on the road ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign tells you that U-turns are not allowed at this location.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign tells drivers that right turns are not allowed in this area.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign shows that you can turn left or go straight ahead from this lane at the intersection.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns that a school crossing is coming up ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns that vehicles parked in this area will be towed away.

questions.question: What is the correct order of traffic lights from top to bottom?
questions.explanation: Traffic lights always have red on top, yellow in the middle, and green on the bottom when arranged vertically. When arranged horizontally, red is on the left and green is on the right.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns that a stop sign is coming up. You should slow down and be ready to come to a complete stop.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Pedestrians walking along the road ahead.
Be alert for construction workers on the road.

questions.explanation: This sign warns that pedestrians may cross the road ahead. Drive with caution in this area.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign is placed at the start of one-way streets and ramps. It means you cannot drive in your current direction.

questions.question: You see a "Merging traffic" sign on the freeway. What should you do?

options.text: Always remain at your present speed.
Speed up to avoid congesting traffic.
Move to another lane, if safe, to let traffic enter.

questions.correctAnswerText: Move to another lane, if safe, to let traffic enter.
questions.explanation: When traffic is merging, move to another lane if it is safe to do so. This helps the entering vehicles merge smoothly.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign means U-turns are not allowed wherever it is posted.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: The highway ahead is under maintenance.

questions.correctAnswerText: The highway ahead is under maintenance.
questions.explanation: Orange construction signs warn drivers about work zones. This sign tells you that construction or maintenance work is ahead. Slow down and drive carefully.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Yellow warning signs tell you about upcoming hazards. This sign warns you that a playground is near. Watch for children on or near the road.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: There is a 35 mph speed zone after the curve.
Do not drive slower than 35 mph around the curve.
A curve is ahead. 35 mph or slower is recommended.
Stay in the right lane if driving slower than 35 mph.

questions.correctAnswerText: A curve is ahead. 35 mph or slower is recommended.
questions.explanation: This sign shows a curve ahead in the direction of the arrow. It recommends driving at 35 mph or slower through the curve.

questions.question: What is the main concern with this sign?

options.text: Your headlights may be misaligned because one side of your car sits higher.
You could damage a tire by drifting onto the shoulder.
You could hydroplane if the shoulder is wet.
You could lose control if you drift onto the shoulder.

questions.correctAnswerText: You could lose control if you drift onto the shoulder.
questions.explanation: This sign means the shoulder is lower than the road. If one wheel drops off the road, do not brake hard or steer sharply. This can cause you to lose control of your vehicle.

questions.question: A sign with this shape and color is a ____ sign.
questions.explanation: Pennant-shaped signs are used only to mark no passing zones.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: You must bear right or left.
A road joins from the right.

questions.correctAnswerText: You must bear right or left.
questions.explanation: This sign shows a Y intersection ahead. You must choose to go either right or left.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: A road joins from the right.

questions.correctAnswerText: A road joins from the right.
questions.explanation: This sign shows an intersection ahead where a road joins from the right.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Orange construction signs warn you about work zones. This sign tells you a flagger is ahead and will direct traffic. Follow their instructions.

questions.question: This sign shows one type of:
questions.explanation: This sign warns that an intersection with a crossing road is ahead.

questions.question: At a school crossing sign, you should:

options.text: Always stop, even if there is no stop sign.
Watch for children and be ready to stop.
Always honk your horn when you see children.
Be ready to help children cross the street.

questions.correctAnswerText: Watch for children and be ready to stop.
questions.explanation: Always let pedestrians cross safely. Watch for children at school crossings and be prepared to stop. Slow down and stay alert.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are diamond-shaped with black markings on a yellow background. They warn drivers about upcoming hazards. This sign warns that a divided highway is coming.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. They warn drivers about upcoming road hazards. This sign warns that farm machinery may be in the area.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Regulation signs tell drivers what they must do. This sign means left turns are not allowed here.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are diamond-shaped with black markings on a yellow background. They warn drivers about upcoming hazards. This sign warns that the road may be slippery when wet, so drive with extra care.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. They warn drivers about upcoming road hazards. This sign warns that an additional lane is being added ahead.

questions.question: What does the posted speed limit show?

options.text: The exact speed at which you must travel to avoid a ticket.
The maximum safe driving speed under ideal road and weather conditions.
The maximum safe driving speed under all road conditions.

questions.correctAnswerText: The maximum safe driving speed under ideal road and weather conditions.
questions.explanation: A speed limit sign shows the highest legal speed for that road. Safe driving may require going slower than the posted limit. When conditions are bad, slow down.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. They warn drivers about upcoming road hazards. This sign warns that lanes are shifting ahead. Follow the new lane path.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: Lane reduction; the right lane ends soon.
Lane reduction; the left lane ends soon.

questions.correctAnswerText: Lane reduction; the right lane ends soon.
questions.explanation: This sign warns that the right lane is ending ahead.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns that a four-way intersection is coming.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Regulation signs tell drivers what they must do. This sign means that when turning left on a green light, you must yield to oncoming traffic. You can complete the turn when it is safe.

questions.question: What does this sign warn drivers about?

options.text: The right lane ends. Traffic must merge left.

questions.correctAnswerText: The right lane ends. Traffic must merge left.
questions.explanation: This sign tells drivers that the right lane will end. Drivers in the right lane must move to the left lane.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This yellow sign with black markings warns drivers to be careful when the road is wet and slippery.

questions.question: What does this sign warn drivers about?

options.text: A curve in the road ahead.

questions.correctAnswerText: A curve in the road ahead.
questions.explanation: This sign tells drivers that the road ahead curves to the right.

questions.question: What can you do from the center lane?
questions.explanation: This lane is only for left turns. You cannot use it to pass other cars or drive straight through.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign means you cannot turn left.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This yellow sign warns drivers that traffic is moving in both directions on the road ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: The road turns sharply right, then left.
The road turns sharply left, then right.
The road curves to the left.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road turns sharply right, then left.
questions.explanation: This sign tells drivers that the road will make a sharp right turn followed by a sharp left turn.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign means it is not safe to enter the road or driveway from your direction. You should turn around and go a different way.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: You must turn left or right.
You are approaching a T intersection.
Your road meets a divided highway.
You are on an overpass above a divided highway.

questions.correctAnswerText: Your road meets a divided highway.
questions.explanation: This sign tells drivers that the road ahead intersects with a divided highway. A divided highway has two one-way roads separated by a median or barrier.

questions.question: What does this sign prevent?

options.text: Entering one-way streets and expressway ramps from the wrong direction.

questions.correctAnswerText: Entering one-way streets and expressway ramps from the wrong direction.
questions.explanation: This sign warns that traffic on this road moves in only one direction. You cannot enter from your current direction.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: The safe speed limit for a residential area.
The safe speed limit for an expressway exit.
The safe speed limit for an expressway entrance.
The safe speed limit for a work zone.

questions.correctAnswerText: The safe speed limit for an expressway exit.
questions.explanation: This sign shows the safe speed for a highway exit. In this example, the safe speed is 30 mph.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This is a warning sign. It is yellow with black markings. It tells you that a yield sign is coming up. Be ready to slow down and let other drivers and pedestrians pass safely.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: The highway ahead is under construction.
The highway ahead has loose gravel on it.
The highway ahead has been sanded for icy conditions.

questions.correctAnswerText: The highway ahead has loose gravel on it.
questions.explanation: This is a warning sign. It is yellow with black markings. It warns you that loose gravel is ahead on the road. Drive with extra caution because your tires will not grip the road as well on gravel.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This is a regulation sign that tells you traffic rules. It shows the direction you must drive on this street.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This is a warning sign. It is diamond-shaped with black markings on a yellow background. It warns you that the divided highway will end soon.

questions.question: What should you do when you see this sign?

options.text: Follow the detour to the right.
Get ready to enter a one-way street.
Stay on the main highway if you can.
Follow the detour to the right only if it is convenient.

questions.correctAnswerText: Follow the detour to the right.
questions.explanation: This is a work area sign. It is orange with black lettering. A detour sign tells you to take an alternate route because the main road is blocked by construction.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
